items.title: How ordering works
items.seoDescription: Standing orders, extras, deadlines and delivery times for Kettle & Crumb wholesale customers.

blocks.heading: A standing order, and extras when you need them
blocks.html:
Most kitchens start with a standing order: the same loaves on the same mornings, week after week. Need more for a busy weekend? Send us a message by 6pm the day before and we will add it.

  • Delivery: Tuesday to Saturday, before 7am
  • Minimum: six loaves per delivery
  • Invoices: monthly, by email

blocks.heading: From our oven to your counter
blocks.body: Everything is baked the same morning it is delivered. If a loaf is not right, tell us and we will replace it the next day, no questions asked.

image.alt: A sourdough loaf cut open to show its crumb

blocks.html:
Orders and questions: wholesale@kettleandcrumb.example or 01234 567891, Tuesday to Saturday from 6am.

Retail customers: the café on Quay Street is open to everyone, see the main site.

items.title: New delivery routes for autumn
items.author: wilma@kettle-and-crumb.test
items.seoDescription: Two new morning routes mean earlier bread for the north side of the harbour.

blocks.html: From next week two new routes cover the north side of the harbour, so bread reaches you before 6:30 instead of after seven. If your kitchen is on Mill Lane, Harbour Road or Pier Street, ask the wholesale desk to move you to an earlier slot.
